question.t: 在決定使用 Flexbox 還是 CSS Grid 時，最核心的判斷依據是什麼？
question.en: What is the core criterion when deciding whether to use Flexbox or CSS Grid?

options.t: 是否需要支援舊版瀏覽器（如 IE11）。
options.en: Whether support for older browsers (like IE11) is required.

options.t: 佈局是單一維度（流向）還是雙維度（區域劃分）。
options.en: Whether the layout is one-dimensional (flow) or two-dimensional (area placement).

options.t: 是否需要垂直置中內容。
options.en: Whether vertical centering of content is needed.

options.t: 子元素的數量是否固定。
options.en: Whether the number of child elements is fixed.

why.t: Flexbox 專為單一維度（1D）的內容流向設計，適合處理一連串的元素；而 Grid 則是為雙維度（2D）設計，適合同時控制行與列的區域劃分。
why.en: Flexbox is designed for one-dimensional (1D) content flow, suitable for a string of elements; whereas Grid is designed for two-dimensional (2D) layouts, suitable for controlling both rows and columns simultaneously.

keywords: CSS Grid, RAM Pattern, Responsive, auto-fit, minmax

question.t: 你需要實作一個「響應式卡片網格」，要求卡片最小寬度為 250px，並自動填滿剩餘空間，且不使用 Media Queries。請問應填入什麼屬性值？
question.en: You need to implement a 'Responsive Card Grid' where cards have a minimum width of 250px and automatically fill the remaining space, without using Media Queries. What property value should be filled in?

options.t: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))
options.en: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))

options.t: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr))
options.en: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr))

options.t: repeat(3, 1fr)
options.en: repeat(3, 1fr)

options.t: flex-wrap: wrap
options.en: flex-wrap: wrap

why.t: 這是經典的 RAM 模式 (Repeat, Auto-fit, Minmax)。使用 `auto-fit` 可以在元素不足以填滿一行時，讓現有元素拉伸填滿空間；而 `minmax(250px, 1fr)` 確保了最小寬度與彈性。
why.en: This is the classic RAM pattern (Repeat, Auto-fit, Minmax). Using `auto-fit` allows existing elements to stretch and fill the space when there aren't enough items to fill a row, while `minmax(250px, 1fr)` ensures minimum width and flexibility.

keywords: Centering, CSS Grid, place-items, Best Practices

question.t: 在現代 CSS 中，若要使用 Grid 以最精簡的語法將單一子元素「水平與垂直完全置中」，應使用哪個屬性？
question.en: In modern CSS, which property should be used to 'perfectly center' a single child element both horizontally and vertically using Grid with the most concise syntax?

options.t: justify-content
options.en: justify-content

options.t: align-items
options.en: align-items

options.t: place-items
options.en: place-items

options.t: text-align
options.en: text-align

why.t: `place-items` 是 `align-items` 與 `justify-items` 的縮寫屬性，設為 `center` 即可同時在兩個維度上置中，是目前最簡潔的「終極置中」方案。
why.en: `place-items` is a shorthand property for `align-items` and `justify-items`. Setting it to `center` centers content in both dimensions simultaneously, making it the most concise 'Super Center' solution currently available.

question.t: 在一個 Flexbox 導航列中，Logo 位於左側，你希望將右側的連結群組 (`.nav-links`) 推到最右邊（Far right），最符合 Flexbox 特性的做法是什麼？
question.en: In a Flexbox navbar with a Logo on the left, you want to push the link group (`.nav-links`) to the far right. What is the most idiomatic Flexbox approach?

options.t: justify-content: space-between (設定在 .nav-links 上)
options.en: justify-content: space-between (set on .nav-links)

options.t: float: right
options.en: float: right

options.t: margin-left: auto
options.en: margin-left: auto

options.t: position: absolute; right: 0;
options.en: position: absolute; right: 0;

why.t: 在 Flex 容器中，對子元素設定 `margin-left: auto` 會佔據該方向上所有剩餘的空間，從而將元素推向最右側。這是 Flexbox 佈局中常見且強大的技巧。
why.en: In a Flex container, setting `margin-left: auto` on a child element consumes all available space in that direction, effectively pushing the element to the far right. This is a common and powerful trick in Flexbox layouts.

question.t: 為什麼在製作「二維網格佈局（2D Grid）」時，使用 Flexbox (`display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap;`) 經常被視為一種反模式（Anti-pattern）？
question.en: Why is using Flexbox (`display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap;`) often considered an anti-pattern when creating a 'Two-Dimensional Grid Layout (2D Grid)'?

options.t: Flexbox 的效能比 Grid 差。
options.en: Flexbox has worse performance than Grid.

options.t: Flexbox 不支援 gap 屬性。
options.en: Flexbox does not support the gap property.

options.t: Flexbox 缺乏「列（Row）」的概念，最後一行的元素可能無法與上方網格對齊（例如會置中或分散）。
options.en: Flexbox lacks the concept of 'Rows', so elements in the last line may not align with the grid above (e.g., they might center or spread out).

options.t: Flexbox 無法處理響應式寬度。
options.en: Flexbox cannot handle responsive widths.

why.t: Flexbox 本質上是流動的（Flow），它只關心元素是否換行，而不會強制建立二維的對齊關係。當最後一行元素數量不足時，它們的行為（如置中或分散）往往會破壞網格的視覺一致性。
why.en: Flexbox is inherently about flow; it only cares about wrapping elements and does not enforce a 2D alignment relationship. When the last row has fewer items, their behavior (like centering or spreading) often breaks the visual consistency of the grid.

keywords: CSS Grid, Grid Areas, Maintainability, Layout Patterns

question.t: 使用 `grid-template-areas` 來定義頁面佈局（如 Header, Sidebar, Content, Footer）的主要優勢是什麼？
question.en: What is the primary advantage of using `grid-template-areas` to define page layouts (like Header, Sidebar, Content, Footer)?

options.t: 它能自動壓縮圖片大小以加快載入速度。
options.en: It automatically compresses images to speed up loading.

options.t: 它讓 CSS 程式碼像 ASCII Art 一樣直觀，極大地提升了可讀性與維護性。
options.en: It makes CSS code look like ASCII Art, greatly improving readability and maintainability.

options.t: 它允許元素在沒有父容器的情況下進行定位。
options.en: It allows elements to be positioned without a parent container.

options.t: 它是唯一支援響應式設計的 Grid 屬性。
options.en: It is the only Grid property that supports responsive design.

why.t: `grid-template-areas` 提供了一種可視化的方式來描述佈局結構，開發者可以直觀地看到各個區域的相對位置，被稱為「Holy Grail」佈局的最佳實踐之一。
why.en: `grid-template-areas` provides a visual way to describe the layout structure. Developers can intuitively see the relative positions of areas, making it one of the best practices for the 'Holy Grail' layout.

question.t: 在響應式設計中，將容器寬度設定為固定像素（如 `width: 960px`）被視為一種「魔術數字（Magic Number）」反模式。這主要會導致什麼問題？
question.en: In responsive design, setting a container width to a fixed pixel value (e.g., `width: 960px`) is considered a 'Magic Number' anti-pattern. What problem does this primarily cause?

options.t: 瀏覽器渲染速度變慢。
options.en: Browser rendering speed slows down.

options.t: 在小螢幕裝置上會出現橫向卷軸，破壞使用者體驗。
options.en: Horizontal scrollbars appear on small screen devices, ruining the user experience.

options.t: 無法使用 Flexbox 或 Grid。
options.en: Flexbox or Grid cannot be used.

options.t: 字體大小會自動變小。
options.en: Font size will automatically shrink.

why.t: 固定寬度無法適應比該寬度更小的螢幕，會強迫瀏覽器顯示橫向卷軸。正確的做法是使用 `max-width` 搭配百分比或 `fr` 單位，讓內容決定高度，容器限制最大寬度。
why.en: Fixed widths cannot adapt to screens smaller than that width, forcing the browser to show horizontal scrollbars. The correct approach is to use `max-width` with percentages or `fr` units, letting content dictate height while the container constrains max width.

keywords: Vertical Rhythm, CSS Gap, Maintainability, Best Practices

question.t: 在現代 CSS 佈局中，使用父容器的 `gap` 屬性來控制子元素之間的垂直間距（如上方程式碼所示），相較於在每個子元素上設定 `margin-bottom`，主要的優勢是什麼？
question.en: In modern CSS layout, what is the primary advantage of using the parent container's `gap` property to control vertical spacing between children (as shown in the code), compared to setting `margin-bottom` on each child element?

options.t: `gap` 屬性會自動增加父容器的 padding，確保內容不貼邊。
options.en: The `gap` property automatically increases the parent container's padding to ensure content doesn't touch the edges.

options.t: 它避免了需要手動移除最後一個元素的 margin（例如使用 `:last-child`），並讓元件在不同上下文中更具可重用性。
options.en: It avoids the need to manually remove the margin from the last element (e.g., using `:last-child`) and makes components more reusable in different contexts.

options.t: `gap` 屬性允許子元素重疊，這在 `margin` 中是不可能的。
options.en: The `gap` property allows child elements to overlap, which is not possible with `margin`.

options.t: 瀏覽器渲染 `gap` 的效能顯著優於 `margin`。
options.en: Browser rendering performance for `gap` is significantly better than for `margin`.

why.t: 使用 `margin-bottom` 時，通常需要額外的 CSS（如 `:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }`）來避免最後一個元素產生多餘的空白。`gap` 屬性僅在元素**之間**產生間距，不需要額外處理，且讓元件本身不帶有外部間距（margin），使其更容易在不同佈局中重用。
why.en: When using `margin-bottom`, extra CSS (like `:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }`) is often required to avoid unwanted space after the last element. The `gap` property applies spacing only **between** elements, requiring no extra handling, and keeps components free of outer margins, making them easier to reuse in different layouts.

keywords: Flexbox, Sidebar Layout, flex-grow, Layout Patterns

question.t: 在手冊提到的「Sidebar Layout」模式中，為什麼要將主要內容區域 (`.content`) 的 `flex-grow` 設定為一個極大的數值（如 `999`），而側邊欄 (`.sidebar`) 僅設為 `1`？
question.en: In the 'Sidebar Layout' pattern mentioned in the handbook, why is the `flex-grow` of the main content area (`.content`) set to a very large number (like `999`), while the sidebar (`.sidebar`) is set to `1`?

options.t: 為了確保 `.content` 的層級（z-index）高於側邊欄。
options.en: To ensure the `.content` has a higher stacking order (z-index) than the sidebar.

options.t: 這是一種 Hack，用來強制瀏覽器在空間不足時優先隱藏側邊欄。
options.en: This is a hack to force the browser to hide the sidebar first when space is insufficient.

options.t: 這讓 `.content` 在空間分配計算中佔據絕對優勢，使側邊欄維持在其 `flex-basis` 寬度，直到容器寬度不足導致換行。
options.en: It gives `.content` dominance in space calculation, keeping the sidebar at its `flex-basis` width until the container is too narrow, causing a wrap.

options.t: 這是為了觸發 GPU 加速渲染。
options.en: This is to trigger GPU accelerated rendering.

why.t: 在 Flexbox 中，剩餘空間是根據 `flex-grow` 的比例分配的。設定 `999` 對 `1` 意味著 `.content` 會吸收幾乎所有的剩餘空間，這實際上迫使 `.sidebar` 保持在其理想寬度（`flex-basis`），而不會被不必要地拉伸，同時在空間不足時能正確觸發換行。
why.en: In Flexbox, remaining space is distributed based on the `flex-grow` ratio. Setting `999` vs `1` means `.content` absorbs almost all available space. This effectively forces `.sidebar` to stay at its ideal width (`flex-basis`) without being stretched unnecessarily, while still triggering a wrap correctly when space is tight.

question.t: 你遇到一個常見的佈局 Bug：當 Grid 或 Flex 子元素包含一長串不換行的文字（如長網址）時，該元素會撐開並導致父容器溢出（Overflow），即使你設定了 `1fr` 或 `flex: 1`。根據手冊，最標準的修復方式是什麼？
question.en: You encounter a common layout bug: when a Grid or Flex child contains a long string of non-wrapping text (like a long URL), it expands and causes the parent container to overflow, even if you set `1fr` or `flex: 1`. According to the handbook, what is the standard fix?

options.t: 在子元素上設定 `overflow: hidden`。
options.en: Set `overflow: hidden` on the child element.

options.t: 在子元素上設定 `min-width: 0`。
options.en: Set `min-width: 0` on the child element.

options.t: 在父容器上設定 `width: 100%`。
options.en: Set `width: 100%` on the parent container.

options.t: 使用 `word-break: break-all` 強制斷行。
options.en: Use `word-break: break-all` to force line breaks.

why.t: 這是 Flexbox 和 Grid 的規範行為：Flex/Grid item 的預設 `min-width` 是 `auto`（即內容的最小寬度）。如果內容無法縮小（如長單字），元素就不會縮小。設定 `min-width: 0` 會覆蓋此預設值，允許元素縮小到小於其內容寬度，進而使 `text-overflow` 或斷行屬性生效。
why.en: This is spec behavior for Flexbox and Grid: the default `min-width` of a flex/grid item is `auto` (the content's minimum size). If content cannot shrink (like a long word), the item won't shrink. Setting `min-width: 0` overrides this default, allowing the item to shrink below its content size, which then allows `text-overflow` or wrapping properties to work.

keywords: Anti-patterns, Absolute Positioning, Document Flow, Layout

question.t: 為什麼將網頁的主要區塊（如 Header, Content, Footer）全部使用 `position: absolute` 進行排版被視為一種「反模式（Anti-pattern）」？
question.en: Why is using `position: absolute` to layout all primary sections of a page (like Header, Content, Footer) considered an 'Anti-pattern'?

options.t: 絕對定位的元素無法使用 `z-index`。
options.en: Absolutely positioned elements cannot use `z-index`.

options.t: 這會導致父容器高度塌陷（Collapse），且元素之間無法根據內容高度自動推擠。
options.en: It causes the parent container's height to collapse, and elements cannot automatically push each other based on content height.

options.t: 現代瀏覽器不再支援 `position: absolute`。
options.en: Modern browsers no longer support `position: absolute`.

options.t: 這會導致 SEO 排名下降，因為搜尋引擎無法讀取絕對定位的內容。
options.en: It causes SEO rankings to drop because search engines cannot read absolutely positioned content.

why.t: 絕對定位會將元素移出「文檔流（Document Flow）」。這意味著父容器不會感知到這些元素的高度，導致高度塌陷（變為 0）。此外，若上方內容變長，下方的絕對定位元素不會自動下移，導致內容重疊。
why.en: Absolute positioning removes elements from the 'Document Flow'. This means the parent container does not perceive the height of these elements, leading to height collapse (becoming 0). Additionally, if content above grows, absolutely positioned elements below won't automatically move down, causing overlap.

question.t: 在設定滿版容器寬度時，使用 `width: 100vw` 相較於 `width: 100%`，經常會導致什麼意外的視覺問題（特別是在 Windows 系統上）？
question.en: When setting a full-width container, what unexpected visual issue does using `width: 100vw` often cause compared to `width: 100%` (especially on Windows systems)?

options.t: 字體渲染會變得模糊。
options.en: Font rendering becomes blurry.

options.t: 會出現不必要的水平卷軸（Horizontal Scrollbar）。
options.en: An unnecessary horizontal scrollbar appears.

options.t: 在行動裝置上無法觸發觸控事件。
options.en: Touch events cannot be triggered on mobile devices.

options.t: 背景顏色會失效。
options.en: Background colors will fail to render.

why.t: `100vw` 代表視口（Viewport）的總寬度，這包含了「垂直卷軸」的寬度（如果存在）。因此，當頁面內容超過一頁高度出現垂直卷軸時，`100vw` 的寬度會比可用的內容區域寬（Content Width + Scrollbar Width），導致內容溢出並出現水平卷軸。`100%` 則通常會自動扣除卷軸寬度。
why.en: `100vw` represents the total width of the viewport, which includes the width of the 'vertical scrollbar' (if present). Therefore, when page content exceeds one page height and a vertical scrollbar appears, `100vw` becomes wider than the available content area (Content Width + Scrollbar Width), causing overflow and a horizontal scrollbar. `100%` usually automatically accounts for the scrollbar width.
